data.description:
Get closer to the **Premier League** like never before with Premier League Player, the first-ever officially licensed VR soccer game.

**Featuring all 20 Premier League teams**, authentic stadiums, and official kits.
![{"height":328,"type":"image","width":1920}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982637_1256086788975407_8536752705492703649_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=jpLhnBHF8PwQ7kNvgFOmzQc&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCrDl8W_pH7e8MV3SXaZdCe5YAjWL3sIYrVQYQrjpTc5Q&oe=675FF763)

# Moments
Step into the action with **Moments mode**, where you can replay highlights from the 2023/24 season. Become a hero for the club you support by scoring game-winning goals, delivering pinpoint assists, and feeling the intensity of every moment as if you were on the field.
{496176953457265}

# Shot Stopper
As the last line of defence, test your reflexes as a Premier League goalkeeper in our **Shot Stopper mode**.
{1115537873623924}

# Headers
Rise above the competition in our **Heading mode**, perfecting the art of accuracy and timing. Jump in solo or with friends in head-to-head or coop mode.
{1149444206802903}

# Free Play
Experience **Freeplay mode**, solo or with friends in local party mode, and sharpen your abilities with tailored Training Drills.
{1279307706541047}

# The Sanctuary
Explore the **Player Sanctuary** to unlock and organise players, make the space your own, and then show off with your friends. Collect achievements and celebrate your journey to becoming a **Premier League Player**.
{1107258291029645}

![{"height":300,"type":"image","width":1920}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974693_1760176544734682_9207197001086630319_n.png?_nc_cat=110&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=lQdL1gWcdrkQ7kNvgE9t_x9&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBrt0Oqp0_MaqNbT9YLH6aG-kHqe7maO8eQdewXLL3ydw&oe=67600FBF)

changelog.change_log:
General Improvements:
- ADDRESSED FRAMERATE DROP AFFECTING PHYSICS AND GAMEPLAY BALL PING OFF'S
- Improved messaging for unlocks and clarified Silver score requirements to access more Moments levels.
- Added shadows under the ball for better visuals.
- Banter board optimized. (Multiplayer Moments)
- Smoother ball movement and rotation (GLOBAL)

Calibration Update:
- Calibration circles offset removed in Moments Multiplayer. Now, all players calibrate in the centre of the pitch!

Player Head Updates:
- Freshened up player heads in Moments and on plinths in the main menu.

Score Messaging:
- Main menu now shows Bronze, Silver, and Gold score requirements for each Moment.
- Post-Moment UI updated to better indicate your achievements and areas for improvement.

Fixes for Moments Multiplayer:
- Aerial target issues resolved.
- Performance in MP moments improved.

*We are also continuing work on Quest 2 regarding framerate but its a tough task given how much is going on with regard to the physics and animation, but users should see a significant improvement from last week. Stay tuned for further Quest 2 updates.*

**Quest 2 casting while playing the game causes framing issues- Avoid**
